source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.1「回転翼航空機（マルチローター）」(1)3)水平回転

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: マルチローターのヨーはCW/CCWローターの反トルクバランスを変化させて生じる。
evidence.tested_misconception: ヨーも左右移動と同じ傾斜制御だけで生じる。
evidence.reasoning_path: counter-rotating rotors -> torque balance -> intentional imbalance -> yaw

collision.note: LOW。Q062はroll方向の移動、Q068はhelicopter tail rotorであり、multirotor yaw torque balanceは別命題。

independent_review.rationale: 4.1 explains multirotor yaw through deliberate imbalance of reaction-torque balance; distinct from Q062 lateral tilt and Q068 helicopter tail-rotor control.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
